candidates.buyer: Livestock holders, livestock traders and assembly points, animal transporters, small slaughter premises, hatcheries and other operators (individuals and family firms)
candidates.category: 6. Livestock traders, markets and animal transport (also 7. small abattoirs and butchers)
candidates.evidence: https://bujqesia.gov.al/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Prezantim-rregullorja-2019.2035.pdf (image-only PDF; I got its content from the search summary and could not read it with WebFetch); https://www.konsultimipublik.gov.al/documents/RENJK_767_Relacion-Projektligji--'P-r-shendetin-e-kafsheve'.doc; https://faolex.fao.org/docs/pdf/alb67403.pdf (Law 8702/2000). Final regulation text, deadlines and transitional period not confirmed.
candidates.existing: No software found for this duty. The state runs the animal registry (system not identified). Competitor search ('ligji 41/2025 ... aplikacion regjistri fermës') found no vendor product.
candidates.name: I02 Animal Health Law 41/2025 operator, establishment and transporter register plus movement traceability for livestock keepers, traders and animal transporters
candidates.trigger: Law 41/2025 'On Animal Health' and a draft regulation aligning with EU Delegated Reg. 2019/2035, presented 29.07.2026. It requires registering operators, establishments and transporters, approving establishments, and individual identification and movement records. It replaces Law 8702/2000 farm registration.
candidates.unchecked: Final text of Law 41/2025 and the regulation; whether it has been adopted; deadline for existing operators to register; whether the state provides a free portal or app (likely); average herd size; who files (farmer or vet).

candidates.buyer: Agricultural pharmacies and pesticide distributors (AKU licence II.5.A) and the farmers who must keep the use register
candidates.category: 14. Pesticide and fertiliser dealers and applicators
candidates.existing: The ministry hands out the paper register itself. Competitor search found no digital product and no confirmed dealer sales-register format.
candidates.name: I04 Farm pesticide-use register and agri-pharmacy sales and traceability pack
candidates.trigger: Plant Protection Law 105/2016 (amended by 15/2022 and 99/2024); Order 275/2022 sets the farm PMB-use register model; CoM Decisions 532/2018 and 317/2019. AKU fined agricultural pharmacies in October 2025 and asks collection points for traceability documents.
candidates.unchecked: Whether dealers must keep a sales register with a set format; how many dealers are licensed; whether a digital farm register is planned. Farmers pay little, so the buyer is probably the dealer.

candidates.buyer: Small waste collectors, haulers, scrap and waste yards, and small producers of non-hazardous waste
candidates.category: 11. Septic, sanitation and waste haulers
candidates.existing: The reporting runs through the state's e-Albania portal. Competitor search ('transportues mbetjesh regjistër ... AKM portal') found no private software.
candidates.name: I03 Waste generator and collector annual transfer reporting and permit pack under Law 57/2025
candidates.trigger: Law 57/2025 (16.10.2025) repealed Law 10463/2011; subordinate acts are still in consultation. Under VKM 229/2014, generators, collectors and receivers of non-hazardous waste file transfer data electronically through e-Albania at least once a year (still in force under the new law: unverified).
candidates.unchecked: Article text on operator registration and a transporter register; transition dates; number of small haulers; whether the e-Albania form is simple enough to leave no gap. Related to K02 (EPR data) and K05 (scrap).

candidates.buyer: Small private employment agencies holding the X.2.A licence
candidates.category: 15. Labour contractors and recruitment agencies
candidates.existing: None found. I did not run a separate local-language competitor search because the budget cap was reached.
candidates.name: I08 Recruitment agency licence-compliance and placement-records pack (Decision 703/2024)
candidates.trigger: CoM Decision 101/2018 on category X.2.A, amended by Decision 703 of 13.11.2024: tighter criteria, a 120-day deadline for existing licensees or revocation, and published data on licensed agencies. Work permits for foreigners (Filipinos, Indians) are rising.
candidates.unchecked: Exact new criteria and reporting duties; number of licensed agencies; whether the 120-day window has closed; a possible new buyer group in category 26 (the firms that hire these workers).

candidates.buyer: Owners of small buildings with lifts, hotels, bakeries and laundries with boilers or pressure vessels, and small inspection and maintenance firms
candidates.category: 12. Lift, boiler and pressure-equipment owners and inspectors
candidates.name: I06 Lift, boiler and pressure-vessel periodic inspection tracker for owners and installers
candidates.trigger: Law 32/2016 on pressure equipment and installations; OMI 029 lists approved bodies for inspecting lifts, boilers and pressure equipment. Periodic intervals were not found.
candidates.unchecked: Inspection intervals, who keeps the register (state inspectorate or approved bodies), enforcement activity, number of lifts and boilers, and a competitor search.

candidates.buyer: Vehicle dismantlers and used-parts sellers
candidates.category: 5. Used car parts and vehicle dismantlers
candidates.name: I07 End-of-life vehicle dismantler and used-parts register
candidates.trigger: CoM Decision 705/2012 on end-of-life vehicles, based on the waste law that Law 57/2025 has now replaced.
candidates.unchecked: Whether any licensed dismantler network exists, deregistration and certificate-of-destruction duties, and the new rules under Law 57/2025.

candidates.buyer: Households employing domestic workers
candidates.category: 1. Household employers: domestic workers, live-in carers, nannies
candidates.name: I01 Household-employer registration and contribution helper
candidates.trigger: MoF Instruction 23/2014: register with the regional tax directorate, get a NIPT, and pay contributions for pension and health only.
candidates.unchecked: Whether the rule still applies and how many households register. Low frequency and likely done on e-Albania.

candidates.buyer: Butchers, small abattoirs and meat sellers
candidates.category: 7. Small abattoirs and butchers
candidates.name: I05 Small slaughter premises and butcher traceability and licence pack
candidates.trigger: Food Law 9863/2008 and AKU enforcement: meat seizures for missing vet documents; a supermarket fined for no traceability system and no HACCP plan. The lot-code rule (K10) is already rejected.
candidates.unchecked: No small-abattoir-specific rule found; may overlap with I02.

candidates.buyer: Jewellers and gold buyers
candidates.category: 4. Gold and jewellery buyers
candidates.name: I09 Gold and jewellery dealer purchase and hallmark register
candidates.trigger: Metrology Law 9875/2008 (relevance not confirmed). Search results were mostly Kosovo's Law 08/L-029.
candidates.unchecked: Whether Albania has a hallmarking or used-gold purchase-register duty, and the anti-money-laundering position of jewellers.

candidates.buyer: Beekeepers and honey packers
candidates.category: 8. Beekeepers
candidates.name: I10 Beekeeper registration and hive records (draft beekeeping law)
candidates.trigger: A draft beekeeping law covering registration, certification and controls was sent to Parliament. Adoption unconfirmed.
candidates.unchecked: Adoption date, records duties, and the number of beekeepers.

candidates.buyer: Private funeral offices and municipal funeral enterprises
candidates.category: 16. Cemeteries, burial societies and funeral services
candidates.name: I11 Funeral and cemetery operator records
candidates.trigger: Law 9220/2004 (amended by 80/2014) and CoM Decision 711/2014 on cemetery administration. No private licence or reporting duty found.
candidates.unchecked: Whether private funeral firms report to the municipality and whether cemeteries need a register of plots.

candidates.buyer: Small associations, foundations and religious bodies
candidates.category: 17. Community and religious bodies: associations, charities, halal and kosher supervision
candidates.name: I12 NPO annual compliance pack (beneficial owner, performance report, Law 80/2021 amendments)
candidates.trigger: Law 80/2021 on NPO registration (amending draft consulted in 2025), beneficial-owner Law 112/2020, and a performance report under Law 25/2018 only above 30 million lek.
candidates.unchecked: Whether the 2025 amendments passed, new deadlines, and how many small NPOs fall under the threshold.

candidates.buyer: Driving schools
candidates.category: 20. Small licensed premises with inspections (driving schools)
candidates.existing: A consumer app 'AutoShkolla Online' (candidate theory practice) was seen: it does not do the school-side register. No school-management software found.
candidates.name: I13 Driving-school candidate registration and fee workflow with DPSHTRR
candidates.trigger: DPSHTRR raised candidate registration fees in 2024 (practical from 1,200 to 2,800 lek, theory from 400 to 1,200 lek). Road Code regulation changes: mandatory requalification courses at licensed schools, instructors may work until age 70. The national driving-school association protested.
candidates.unchecked: Which registers schools keep for DPSHTRR, how many schools, and whether the state portal handles registration.

candidates.buyer: Private kindergartens and nurseries
candidates.category: 20. Small licensed premises with inspections (childminders and nurseries)
candidates.evidence: https://shqiptarja.com/lajm/taskforca-per-kopshtet-private-policia-kontrolluam-201-subjekte-81-ishin-pa-licence-nen-hetim-pronaret-dhe-administratoret; https://avokatipopullit.gov.al/media/manager/website/reports/Rekomandim për përmirësimin e akteve nënligjore në zbatim të legjislacionit të arsimit parauniversitar dhe licencave në RSH në me qëllim mbrojtjen e fëmijëve.pdf
candidates.name: I14 Private nursery and kindergarten licence and inspection records
candidates.trigger: After the 2023 'Stinët' case, police inspected 201 operators, 81 had no licence, and 63 owners or administrators are under investigation. The Ombudsman has recommended improvements to the by-laws. A 2022 draft moves licence handling to the national business centre (QKB).
candidates.unchecked: Current licence regime, recurring reporting duties and the number of operators.

coverage.category: 1. Household employers: domestic workers, live-in carers, nannies
coverage.found: Head of household registers with the regional tax directorate and gets a NIPT (MoF Instruction 23/2014, per tatime.gov.al results); domestic workers get a pension and health booklet only. Annual register of employees and payroll filing apply. Nothing found on a family-caregiver category. Low frequency, probably handled in e-Albania. Weak (I01).

coverage.category: 2. Scrap-metal dealers
coverage.found: Nothing new beyond K05. Found a type B environmental permit for storing scrap (Law 52/2020 amending 10448/2011) and CoM Decision 117/2013 on end-of-waste criteria for scrap metal. No Albanian licensing or purchase-register rule located.

coverage.category: 3. Second-hand dealers and pawnbrokers
coverage.found: No dedicated search (budget). The gold/jewellery search returned no Albanian second-hand or pawnbroker rule either.

coverage.category: 4. Gold and jewellery buyers
coverage.found: One search; results were mostly Kosovo (Law 08/L-029 on precious-metal articles). For Albania only the Metrology Law 9875/2008 was found. No purchase-register or hallmark duty confirmed. Unverified (I09).

coverage.category: 5. Used car parts and vehicle dismantlers
coverage.found: CoM Decision 705/2012 on end-of-life vehicles (M1, N1) rests on Law 10463/2011, which Law 57/2025 repealed on 16.10.2025. Dismantler licence conditions and any reporting were not found. Unverified (I07).

coverage.category: 6. Livestock traders, markets and animal transport
coverage.found: New Animal Health Law 41/2025. A draft regulation (presented 29.07.2026) implements EU Delegated Reg. 2019/2035: register operators, establishments and transporters, approve establishments, and keep traceability of animal movements. It replaces the older Law 8702/2000 farm registration. Candidate I02.

coverage.category: 7. Small abattoirs and butchers
coverage.found: AKU enforcement news: meat seized for missing veterinary documents, product certificates and invoice traceability; a supermarket was fined 1,000,000 lek for no licence and 100,000 lek for no traceability system. No small-abattoir-specific rule found. Folded into I02 and I05.

coverage.category: 8. Beekeepers
coverage.found: A draft beekeeping law (registration of beekeepers, controls) was approved by the Council of Ministers and sent to Parliament under minister Krifca. Adoption and date not confirmed. Weak (I10).

coverage.category: 9. Veterinary practices and veterinary medicine sellers
coverage.found: No dedicated search (budget); K04 already covers the vet antimicrobial register. The Law 41/2025 search is relevant to vets only through the operator registers.

coverage.category: 10. Well drillers and water abstraction
coverage.found: One search found no Albanian well-permit or abstraction-reporting rule; only the ERRU water regulator's reports (17 water utilities) and Law 111/2012 on integrated water resources, which was not checked. Nothing to report.

coverage.category: 11. Septic, sanitation and waste haulers
coverage.found: New Law 57/2025 on integrated waste management (16.10.2025) with subordinate acts in consultation (waste export, separate collection, hospital waste). Under VKM 229/2014, generators, collectors and receivers of non-hazardous waste send transfer data electronically through e-Albania at least once a year. Whether that still applies is unverified. Candidate I03.

coverage.category: 12. Lift, boiler and pressure-equipment owners and inspectors
coverage.found: Law 32/2016 on pressure equipment and installations. OMI 029 lists approved inspection bodies for pressure equipment, boilers and lifts. Periodic-inspection intervals and a register were not found. Unverified (I06).

coverage.category: 13. Small water systems
coverage.found: No dedicated search (budget). The water-abstraction search returned only ERRU material.

coverage.category: 14. Pesticide and fertiliser dealers and applicators
coverage.found: Plant Protection Law 105/2016 (amended 2022 and 2024), CoM Decisions 317/2019 (user qualification) and 532/2018 (trade, transport, storage). Dealers are licensed by AKU (Law 10081/2009, II.5.A). Farmers keep a paper register of PMB use (Order 275/2022); 3,381 registers were distributed and 3,021 farmers inspected in 2024. AKU fined agricultural pharmacies in Oct 2025. Candidate I04.

coverage.category: 15. Labour contractors and recruitment agencies
coverage.found: Private employment agencies need a licence under category X.2.A (CoM Decision 101/2018). Decision 703 of 13.11.2024 tightened the criteria: existing holders had 120 days to comply or lose the licence, and the ministry can revoke. Candidate I08.

coverage.category: 16. Cemeteries, burial societies and funeral services
coverage.found: Law 9220/2004 on burial services (amended by Law 80/2014) and CoM Decision 711/2014 on cemetery rules. Municipalities delegate cemetery upkeep to municipal funeral enterprises. No private licensing or reporting duty found. Weak (I11).

coverage.category: 17. Community and religious bodies: associations, charities, halal and kosher supervision
coverage.found: Law 80/2021 on NPO registration (an amending draft was consulted in 2025; adoption unconfirmed), beneficial-owner Law 112/2020, and a performance report required under Law 25/2018 only above 30 million lek. Nothing on halal supervision. Weak (I12).

coverage.category: 18. Transport operators: minibus, taxi, moto-taxi, small trucking and bus fleets
coverage.found: One search. Only the 2016 licensing Instruction 5627 (updated 2020, good-repute and financial-capacity rules). No taxi, minibus or tachograph rule found for Albania; the results were for other countries. Nothing new.

coverage.category: 19. Market traders, street vendors, money changers
coverage.found: No search (budget). Money changers are covered by K03.

coverage.category: 20. Small licensed premises with inspections: tattoo studios, driving schools, childminders and nurseries, small food producers, hunting outfitters
coverage.found: Driving schools and private nurseries screened. Driving schools: DPSHTRR raised candidate registration fees in 2024, the national driving-school association protested, and the Road Code regulation changed. Private nurseries: police inspected 201 operators and 81 had no licence after the 2023 'Stinët' case. Tattoo studios, small food producers and hunting outfitters not searched.

candidates.buyer: Small hotels, restaurants, builders, shops and call-centre firms hiring non-EU workers
candidates.category: 31. Employers of foreign workers
candidates.existing: Competitor search (Albanian) found no named private software or platform; only the e-Albania/AKPA online flow and general consulting advice. Law firms and agencies may offer manual services (unchecked).
candidates.name: Foreign-worker permit and renewal service for small employers
candidates.score_note: Growing market, recurring per-worker deadlines, mandatory; risk is a done-for-you service rather than software and that e-Albania handles most steps.
candidates.trigger: Law 79/2021 on Foreigners as amended Feb 2023: unique permit (work approval by AKPA online, then residence by Border and Migration police). Permits and renewals recur per worker. 18,156 online employment requests approved in 2025; 22.6k foreign workers by June 2026.
candidates.unchecked: Employer-side recurring duties (notification of termination, renewal windows, fines), number of employers, existing agencies and law-firm fees, whether e-Albania already reminds renewals, and bureaucratic delay rates.

candidates.buyer: Condominium administrators, small property managers, hotels and small businesses owning lifts
candidates.category: 35. Lifts, condominium administrators and pressure equipment (also group A cat. 12)
candidates.existing: No competitor search run (budget exhausted). None seen in results.
candidates.name: Lift certification and maintenance tracker for building administrators and lift owners
candidates.trigger: ISHMT registration, safety certificate and periodic inspection by authorised bodies (VKM 1056/2015 per a tender spec; Law 10112/2009 on condominium administration). Over 8,800 lifts uncertified in 2021; the ministry announced EU-standard certification for installers.
candidates.unchecked: Whether inspections are actually enforced (only 52-114 administrative measures a year), inspection frequency, real number of administrators with a legal duty, competitor tools, willingness to pay of unpaid volunteer administrators.

candidates.buyer: Small wineries, raki distillers, craft breweries, small importers and distributors of alcohol and tobacco
candidates.category: 32. Excise stamps and excise-goods authorisations
candidates.existing: None found; competitor search not run. Unknown whether customs offers an online stamp-order portal.
candidates.name: Excise-stamp ordering and inventory register for small wine, raki, beer and tobacco importers and producers
candidates.trigger: Customs Instruction 14 of 30 June 2026 on applying fiscal stamps to tobacco, beer, wine and spirits (Law 61/2012); excise-warehouse authorisation for producers.
candidates.unchecked: Actual stamp ordering, stock reconciliation and reporting duties (PDF unreadable), number of small producers, whether Customs' own portal covers it, frequency.

candidates.buyer: Small collection centres, drying and processing firms and exporters of sage, oregano, thyme, etc.
candidates.category: 33. Wild medicinal and aromatic plant collectors, collection centres and exporters (also cat. 30)
candidates.existing: No competitor search run. UNIDO guides exist but are not software.
candidates.name: Wild medicinal and aromatic plant collection-centre and export compliance pack
candidates.trigger: Forestry-service harvest permission under the plant-protection law, export documentation and EU import rules; roughly 90% of volume is wild collected and the value chain lacks transparency.
candidates.unchecked: Current permit, quota and traceability duties; whether any register is mandatory and filed periodically; number of firms; buyer reachability.

candidates.category: 28. Notaries, land agents, real estate brokers and other professionals
candidates.known_note: Same type of AML duty as K03 but a different buyer group.
candidates.name: Real estate mediator register and AML compliance kit
candidates.trigger: Law 9/2022 on the profession of real estate mediator (Ministry of Justice register); AML Law 9917/2008 with the DPPPP.
candidates.unchecked: Whether mediators are reporting entities under the AML law, thresholds, report formats, frequency, number of agencies; DPPPP site not reached.

candidates.buyer: About 189 private physical security firms

candidates.name: Small private security company licence and staff register tool
candidates.trigger: Law 75/2014 and Law 10081/2009 licence category 1.3.A; electronic equipment duty (Art. 32).
candidates.unchecked: Recurring reports to State Police, guard register format, licence renewal cycle.

candidates.buyer: Small licensed construction firms

candidates.name: Construction licence technical-manager and compliance tracker
candidates.trigger: CoM Decision 30 of 2 July 2025 amending VKM 42/2008 (technical manager may serve only one company; applications via e-Albania, 20 days); planned permit registry and 5-year blacklist.
candidates.unchecked: Recurring filings by contractors, licence renewal cycle, number of firms.

candidates.trigger: Municipal licence under Law 8450 and VKM 970/2015 (5-year licence, fee 1M lek per an Elbasan notice); metrological verification of dispensers by concessionaire Noa Control; fuel marking.
candidates.unchecked: Verification cycle, who bills it, any annual returns; low frequency makes it unlikely.

candidates.name: Savings-credit company (SHKK) compliance reporting
candidates.trigger: Law 52/2016 and Bank of Albania licensing regulation (2016, amended).
candidates.unchecked: Number of active entities (a revocation list suggests few), reporting formats; likely too small a market.

candidates.existing: None seen; clinic management software likely exists (unchecked).

candidates.unchecked: Actual billing format, whether the Fund supplies its own system, vendor landscape.

candidates.buyer: Informal room, apartment and villa owners (said to be about 4,500 structures)

candidates.known_note: Same buyer group and duty as K01; not re-checked.
candidates.name: Accommodation categorisation and electronic guest register for informal rooms and villas
candidates.trigger: 2024 tourism bill: QKB registration, categorisation certificate, electronic guest register; fines 20k-400k lek.
candidates.unchecked: Final adoption of the law and effective date.

candidates.buyer: Cannabis licence applicants (USD 1M capital, 51% ownership rules)
candidates.category: 34. Medical and industrial cannabis licensing
candidates.name: Medical and industrial cannabis licensee compliance
candidates.trigger: 2023 cannabis law, National Cannabis Control Agency; bylaws still missing as of Jan 2025.
candidates.unchecked: Whether licences have been issued; buyers are few and well capitalised, so out of scope for quiet small firms.

coverage.category: 21. Fuel stations and fuel or LPG distributors
coverage.found: Retail fuel and LPG sale is licensed by municipalities (Law 8450, VKM 970/2015 per Elbasan notice, Nov 2025; 5-year licence; fines 700k-1M lek for unlicensed trading). ERE only licenses small LNG/CNG plants (Sept 2026). Pump verification moved to concessionaire Noa Control (2020); fuel marking is a private concession since 2013. Hydrocarbon strategic reserves draft law pending. No operator-side recurring filing found that small software would fix. Nothing strong.

coverage.category: 22. Grain, coffee, cocoa and other commodity traders, millers and warehouses
coverage.found: No search spent: budget. Albania has no obvious grain/commodity regime. Closest work was done under 33 (medicinal plants) and 30.

coverage.category: 23. Co-operatives, credit unions and savings groups
coverage.found: Savings-credit companies (SHKK) are licensed and supervised by the Bank of Albania under Law 52/2016 and a 2016 licensing regulation, not by AMF. Few entities; no 2025 reporting change found. Weak. Agricultural co-operatives not searched.

coverage.category: 24. Private clinics, labs and other health providers that bill insurers or state schemes
coverage.found: FSDKSH contracts private providers via e-Albania, which requires a database the Fund can access online. A Vetting/News24 audit (2024 data) flags payment and e-prescription problems. No 2025 billing law or provider-side reporting duty found. Nothing new beyond existing portals.

coverage.category: 25. Pharmacies, medicine importers, and users of controlled chemicals or precursors
coverage.found: Narcotics law 7975/1995 and psychotropic substances law 8750/2001 exist. The search returned no pharmacy reporting rule for 2026. E-prescription programme exists, run by the state or Fund with vendor disputes (pharmacists' order objected to a paid maintenance contract). Nothing verifiable.

coverage.category: 26. Security, cleaning and manpower agencies, and the firms that hire their workers
coverage.found: Private security (SHPSF) licensed by State Police under Law 75/2014 and Law 10081/2009, category 1.3.A. A 2022 government report counted 189 entities and 8,737 staff. Electronic equipment duty under Article 32. A 2022 draft would add a training-centre sub-category 1.3.C; adoption unconfirmed. Cleaning and manpower agencies: nothing found. Employers of foreign workers moved to 31.

coverage.category: 27. Construction, mining and quarry contractors and suppliers: site registers, accreditation, local-content reports
coverage.found: CoM Decision 30 of 2 July 2025 amended VKM 42/2008 on construction professional licences: licensing commission reviews within 20 days via e-Albania, a technical manager may serve only one construction company. Government plans a national electronic permit registry and a 5-year blacklist; tourist-zone construction suspended to 15 Sept 2026. Duties fall mainly on the state or on mid-sized firms. Weak.

coverage.category: 28. Notaries, land agents, real estate brokers and other professionals with periodic or anti-money-laundering reports
coverage.found: Real estate mediators are covered by Law 9/2022, with a Ministry of Justice register (Order 183 of 4 May 2022). The AML base law is 9917/2008 with the DPPPP as FIU. I could not confirm the current list of reporting entities, thresholds or any 2025 goAML registration duty (searches returned only foreign sources). Candidate kept as unverified-leaning weak.

coverage.category: 29. Hotels, guest houses and short-term rentals: guest registers, tourism levies
coverage.found: Nothing new beyond K01. Feb 2024 tourism bill (Shqiptarja): all accommodation must be licensed; informal rooms and villas register with QKB then apply for a categorisation certificate (fines 20k-400k lek); electronic guest register with nights, nationality, age, gender; fines of 100k lek for inaccurate guest data and 150k lek for not declaring guests. Final adoption and dates not confirmed. INSTAT publishes monthly accommodation statistics.

coverage.category: 30. Small exporters and importers facing traceability or certification rules: food, fish, timber, forest-risk commodities
coverage.found: Fishing falls under Law 64/2012 and a 2013 IUU/catch-certificate decision. A 2025 AGRINFO guide covers EU aquaculture export rules. Government co-funds Friend of the Sea certification. No small-firm recurring duty identified beyond the wild-plant chain (33). Nothing new beyond K10 for food labelling.

coverage.category: 31. Employers of foreign workers (Law 79/2021 on Foreigners, unique permit)
coverage.found: Unique permit regime since Feb 2023. AKPA approved online 18,156 employment requests in 2025; foreign workers employed reached 22.6k by June 2026 (State Police), up from 18.1k in Dec 2025. Main sectors: accommodation and food, construction, trade. Employers (often small hotels, restaurants, builders, call-centre firms) file permits and renewals through e-Albania. Candidate created.

coverage.category: 32. Excise stamps and excise-goods authorisations (tobacco, beer, wine, spirits)
coverage.found: Customs Instruction 14 of 30 June 2026 sets fiscal-stamp application rules for tobacco, beer, wine and spirits (Law 61/2012). Wine and raki producers must be authorised as excise-warehouse keepers. Producers under 100 litres per year for household use only notify Customs. The PDF text could not be read, so stamp-ordering and reporting duties are unconfirmed.

coverage.category: 33. Wild medicinal and aromatic plant collectors, collection centres and exporters
coverage.found: Albania ranks among the top 25 exporters; about 90% is wild collected. The older law on the protection of natural medicinal, ether-oil and tannin plants requires permission from the forestry service for harvesting. UNIDO publishes collection and export guides. 2025 drought and fires hit collectors. Current permit and quota mechanics unconfirmed.

coverage.category: 34. Medical and industrial cannabis licensing (2023 law)
coverage.found: The law created a National Cannabis Control Agency. Licensing requires 3 years' experience, about USD 1M capital and 51% local ownership, with 5-10 ha per licensee. As of a January 2025 report, bylaws were still missing. Buyers are well-capitalised, not quiet small firms; out of scope.

coverage.category: 35. Lifts, condominium administrators and pressure equipment (ISHMT)
coverage.found: Lifts: the building administrator must register each lift with ISHMT, hold a maintenance contract and arrange periodic inspection by an authorised body. Shqiptarja (21 Aug 2024): 2021 investigation found over 8,800 of 10,000+ lifts uncertified; ISHMT registry 2,684 by 2024; 6 authorised inspection bodies; Tirana has 1,113 certified administrators, Durrës 8, Elbasan none. Pressure equipment: Law 32/2016. A tender spec cites VKM 1056/2015 inspection twice a year (unconfirmed).

coverage.category: 36. General licensing law 10081/2009 (amended by Law 41/2025) and online betting licences
coverage.found: Law 41/2025 of 26 June 2025 amends Law 10081 to cut administrative barriers; amended text and annex could not be fetched (QKB PDF returned 404). A betting licensing law with up to 10 licences was reported; buyers are large operators, out of scope.
